title: The Stress Fracture
logline: A shipyard chief tries to patch a cracked freighter spine with cosmetic plating, while a union safety inspector threatens a walkout that will paralyze the system's shipping lanes.

roles.description: Oversees orbital gantry overhauls under strict penalty clauses; exhausted, calculating, and smelling of burnt hydraulic fluid.
A veteran dock safety assessor who refuses to certify pressurized bulkheads without verified acoustic scans.
A powerful logistics syndicate that faces heavy demurrage fines if bulk ore haulers miss scheduled convoy gates.
Orbital yard fitters and welders who stage wildcat walkouts whenever structural safety protocols are bypassed.
A high-orbit gantry cradle clamped around the warped hull of a laden ore transport.
An armed security cutter dispatched by dispatchers to prevent unauthorized dock strikes.

public_situation: A deep-draft bulk hauler is locked in the orbital slipway with an unconfirmed hull fracture while departure deadlines tick down.
private_truth: The chief engineer concealed acoustic test results showing the main thrust spine is fractured, gambling that the hull will survive one more transit.

beats.public_change: The consortium requests emergency transit couriers to ferry replacement bulkhead plates from an off-station depot.

missions.reason: He needs high-tensile structural plating purchased and delivered off the record before the formal safety shift begins.
missions.private_fact: He plans to weld cosmetic patch plates over the fractured spine to conceal the structural crack from regulators.

beats.public_change: Dockside rumors spread that the hauler's spine popped under cold-docking pressure, prompting a snap union inspection.

missions.reason: She needs independent external sensor scans of the hauler's thrust frame before the engineer can seal the gantry umbilical.
missions.private_fact: She was demoted two years ago after signing off on a similar stressed hull that ruptured near a jump gate.

beats.public_change: Union reps threaten to cut umbilical power unless the station magistrate impounds the vessel for acoustic disassembly.

missions.reason: She needs certified acoustic sensor logs delivered to the yard magistrate's intake office before the consortium can force a launch clearance.
missions.private_fact: She knows the consortium has already paid the magistrate's clerk to misfile any unsealed paper filings.

player_choice.prompt: The acoustic logs confirm the hull will likely tear apart under main burn, but filing them will bankrupt the shipyard and trigger massive contract lawsuits.

options.label: Deliver the evidence to the dockside union to trigger a general yard shutdown
Return the logs to the chief engineer for a private cash settlement
Submit the evidence directly to harbor navigation to revoke the hauler's transponder

beats.public_change: Consortium security deploys an armed cutter to break the union picket and manually cycle the gantry release clamps.

missions.reason: She needs the armed enforcer driven back before security forces open fire on picketing dock mechanics at the umbilical locks.
missions.private_fact: The enforcer captain offers to transfer the hauler's emergency fuel allocation codes in exchange for being allowed to decouple the ship.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot breaks the consortium security cutter and delivers proof to the union, halting the launch.
resolutions.summary: {role:dockside_union} shuts down the slipway. The hauler is condemned for drydock rebuild, and {role:chief_engineer} faces criminal negligence inquiries.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended shipyard picketers and grounded a freighter whose spine was cracked.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the consortium payoff or the enforcer captain's offer, allowing the cosmetic patch to proceed.
resolutions.summary: The cosmetic patch is signed off and the hauler slips its moorings into the shipping lane. {role:chief_engineer} pockets his bonus while dock workers protest.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot routes the structural evidence to harbor authorities to freeze the slipway legally.
resolutions.summary: Harbor control locks the gantry clamps. {role:freight_consortium} forfeits its transit bond, while {role:dockside_union} wins an audited inspection schedule.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot provides inconclusive scans, or never gets involved.
resolutions.summary: The uninspected freighter fires main thrusters and suffers catastrophic frame shear near the gate, closing the lane and bankrupting the repair gantry.

loose_threads.detail: The delivery crates of replacement high-tensile plates were signed by a shipping broker who vanished from station manifests.
The hauler's demurrage bond includes an indemnity rider paying three times market value if the hull is condemned in port.

radio_hooks: Ore hauler departure delayed in orbital slipway amid unconfirmed hull weld rumors.
{role:dockside_union} warns of immediate walkout if uncertified hulls are released.
{role:freight_consortium} denies structural damage, citing routine telemetry updates.

voice_direction.chief_engineer: Speaks in tense, rushed bursts with repeated references to contractual deadlines. Evades direct questions about acoustic scan readings.
voice_direction.safety_inspector: Flat, measured, and deliberate. Uses bureaucratic terminology as armor and refuses to let others interrupt her technical descriptions.
